description: Use for one past, completed UTC day of crypto-only news. For all markets on a past day use get_news_day; for the last 48 hours use get_crypto_news. Historical scores are retrospective. One stored UTC day of crypto-labelled news with retrospective scores: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: date: required completed UTC day YYYY-MM-DD; market_catalogue.available_days lists available days; tag: optional lower-case label; relevant: optional true; sentiment: optional positive, neutral, negative or unscored stored label; missing labels do not match; q: optional keyword search in headline titles, 2-60 characters. Costs $0.05 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

date.description: A completed UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD. The free market_catalogue tool lists the days on sale in available_days (also GET /health).

first_in_group.description: Optional true: keep records explicitly marked repeat_first=true. Missing flags are excluded; groups are source-defined and do not guarantee unique real-world events. Omit to retain all observations.

q.description: Optional keyword or phrase, 2 to 60 characters, matched case-insensitively in the headline title, such as ETF or rate cut. A paid request with no matching headline is refused before any charge.

relevant.description: Optional: true keeps only market-relevant records: a market, ticker, crypto asset, exchange or event label, a Binance announcement, or an AI score away from neutral (positive or negative). Drops general news such as sport and politics without market content.

sentiment.description: Optional stored sentiment label: positive, neutral, negative or unscored. Records without a stored label do not match, including unscored.

tag.description: Optional label to match, lower case: a ticker (btc, nvda, eurusd, xau), a topic or an event type (token_listing, etf_approval).

name: get_crypto_news_day
title: Pay: Historical crypto news day
